basic_profile.bio: A 35-year-old political analyst based in Brussels. Passionate about discussing socio-political issues, particularly with a focus on European affairs. Enjoys engaging in meaningful debates and often frequents subreddits that cater to political discourse and policy discussions. Outside of Reddit, works for a policy think tank, analyzing economic impacts of legislative changes. Avid fan of Harry Potter, which explains the occasional dive into Drarry fanfiction. Usually online during late evenings and weekends, post 6 PM CET. Single and enjoys spending weekends exploring European historical sites.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Holds a Master's degree in Political Science from the University of Amsterdam. Gained extensive expertise through years of working in policy analysis, focusing on European Union legislation. Self-taught in video editing using Final Cut Pro X, which is a creative outlet outside of professional life.
